# Audit schema v1

Every audit record is an OTLP LogRecord with EventName `audit` and the
attributes below, and no others (the closed set). Go writers spell keys
through the generated `audit.Key*` constants and test their records with
`audit.Check` and `audittest`; other writers use `cmd/auditschema`.

## Writers

| writer | code | who |
|---|---|---|
| `request` | H | A person's request, recorded by snowplow. |
| `gateway` | G | The agent gateway's hop record, projected by the collector. |
| `action` | T | An agent's per-action record, written by whatever performs the action. |
| `controller` | C | A controller reconcile. |

## Levels

- **R**: required. **R (mark)**: required, or omitted and named in
  `krateo.audit.incomplete` when the writer cannot establish it.
- **C: when**: required when *when* holds. **[checked]**: `Check` evaluates the
  condition on the record. Without it, the condition is not visible on the
  record and `Check` treats the key as optional, unless it is **(mark)**: then
  it must be present or marked.
- **O**: optional. **NE**: not established by this writer, never written.
  **—**: does not apply.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| `krateo.audit.schema_version` | string | none | R | R | R | R | The schema version the record was written to. Tells migrated rows apart. One of `1`. |

## The target rule

Every record names its target: `krateo.audit.object_ref.resource` (a Kubernetes object) or `server.address`
(an external endpoint). Marker `target`.

| writer | targets |
|---|---|
| `request` | exactly one |
| `gateway` | exactly one |
| `action` | exactly one |
| `controller` | at least one |

## Conditions `Check` evaluates

- `k8s_target`: The record names a Kubernetes object: k8s.namespace.name or any krateo.audit.object_ref.* key is present.
- `write`: krateo.audit.verb is a write: create, update, patch, delete, deletecollection (a Kubernetes object), post or put (anything else).
- `method_other`: http.request.method is _OTHER: the writer was given a method semconv does not name.
- `delegated`: The record carries a delegation: krateo.audit.delegation or krateo.audit.on_behalf_of.user.name is present.
- `impersonated`: The record carries an impersonation: either krateo.audit.impersonated_user.* key is present.

## v0.3 keys (migration window W1)

Written side by side with their replacement by v0.4.x, with the same value,
and removed in v0.5.0. Readers `coalesce` the two until the last row without
`krateo.audit.schema_version` expires. `Emit` adds the ones marked
"yes"; the others it writes only when the caller sets them.

| v0.3 key | replaced by | added by `Emit` |
|---|---|---|
| `outcome` | `krateo.audit.outcome` | yes |
| `enduser.id` | `user.name` | no: only where it is written today |
| `k8s.resource.group` | `krateo.audit.object_ref.api_group` | yes |
| `k8s.resource.version` | `krateo.audit.object_ref.api_version` | yes |
| `k8s.resource.resource` | `krateo.audit.object_ref.resource` | yes |
| `k8s.resource.subresource` | `krateo.audit.object_ref.subresource` | yes |
| `k8s.resource.kind` | `krateo.audit.object_ref.kind` | yes |
| `k8s.resource.name` | `krateo.audit.object_ref.name` | yes |
| `k8s.object.uid` | `krateo.audit.object_ref.uid` | yes |
| `k8s.object.generation` | `krateo.audit.object_ref.generation` | yes |
| `k8s.object.resource_version` | `krateo.audit.object_ref.resource_version` | yes |

## Emit never drops a record

A record missing a key its writer must write is emitted without it, and
`krateo.audit.incomplete` names the missing key's marker (for a record with no
actor: `actor`). Each marker is counted under
`krateo.audit.records.incomplete{marker}`. `Check` reports such a key as
`incomplete`.

## Where each writer's records land

| instrumentation scope | writer | who |
|---|---|---|
| `github.com/krateo-platformops/snowplow/audit` | `request` | snowplow (H, and T for an agent going through /call) |
| `github.com/krateo-platformops/observability/gateway-audit` | `gateway` | the collector's gateway-audit projection |
| `github.com/krateo-platformops/audit` | `controller` | access-review and identity-lifecycle (split by ServiceName) |
| `rest-dynamic-controller/audit` | `controller` | rest-dynamic-controller |
| `request` | `gateway` | the agent gateway's pre-2026-10-22 access-log rows (pre-schema, the positive control) |
